name: Crowley Jacksonville Distribution Center (Dry/LCL) - Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.facility: Crowley Jacksonville Dry/LCL Distribution Center, 2113 W 30th Street. Identified positively by CROWLEY-branded trailers backed into the dock face in 2025-03 Street View. The roster's geocoded point landed on this white L-shaped warehouse; the brown-roofed building to the north is a separate tenant ('USA Big Mountain Paper, 2160').
fieldNotes.truckGate: The fenced truck yard (chain-link perimeter) is entered from the unnamed industrial street on the SW side. Street View shows a chain-link gate opening; no barrier-arm at the public road but a controlled fenced yard entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the yard gate. Web research confirms 24/7 security monitoring (camera/electronic), consistent with remote check-in rather than a manned booth — classified remoteGs.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Web research (Crowley/Racklify listings) states 27 dock doors at the 100,418 sq ft facility. Satellite + Street View confirm two dock banks: a west-face bank (~7-8 doors) and a south-east-face bank (~10+ doors with CROWLEY trailers backed in) — band 25-50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors are split across two physically separate building faces of the L-shaped warehouse (a west bank and a south-east bank), supporting separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 trailers parked in the yard south/east of the building (CROWLEY trailers and others); not a large dedicated drop lot but a working trailer yard.
fieldNotes.bonded: Facility is a U.S. Customs bonded warehouse (LCL consolidation/deconsolidation, dry cargo, plus an in-building CrowleyFresh cold-storage section).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large open paved truck apron in front of the dock banks easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Jacksonville's NW industrial fabric near JAXPORT — Urban.
fieldNotes.confidence: High — facility positively identified by Crowley branding on docked trailers; dock count corroborated by web research; layout, gate, and yard clearly visible in 2025 Street View and Maxar satellite. Lane counts and exact drop-yard capacity remain estimates.
